intro: Assassination Plot is a Horde quest initiated by recovering intercepted centaur orders in Thousand Needles. The orders reveal an impending strike targeting the tauren Kanati Greycloud at his hunting camp by Whitereach Post.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Tauren, Kanati Greycloud is bold to set up a hunting camp in Thousand Needles. We must kill him to rid this hunting camp and all who may follow him. We will converge at the small post Southwest of the Great Lift.

clips.title: Completion
paras: They come to kill me? I will show them how a Tauren fights!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
